additions.name: calendar_sync_run
additions.reason: Issue #316: one-way reconcile of timed notes to the configured Google calendar (insert/patch/delete through the Google outbox). Filesystem walk, ledger/outbox writes and the gws drain run inside an awaited spawn_blocking worker; the same function is the maru calendar-sync CLI entry.

additions.name: write_recovery_copy
additions.reason: Phase 9 D-08: a failed teardown save is preserved as a real file under <work>/.maru/recovery/. The size cap, admission, symlink refusal, naming and the no-clobber write all run inside an awaited spawn_blocking worker.

additions.name: list_architecture_blueprints
additions.reason: Issue #410: read-only architecture gallery listing of archify *-rendered.html viewers in dev/ and sites/ submodules. The git submodule listing, flat directory scans and spec title reads run inside an awaited spawn_blocking worker.

additions.name: prepare_architecture_blueprint
additions.reason: Issue #410: validates one listed viewer by canonical path against a rescan and grants that single file to the asset protocol, inside an awaited spawn_blocking worker.

additions.name: architecture_read_sibling_spec
additions.reason: Issue #433: read-only sibling <slug>.architecture.json read for the architecture gallery. A fresh listing rescan proves blueprint membership, then the spec gets its own canonicalization, submodule-containment, 1 MiB size cap and schema checks (diagram_type architecture, numeric schema_version), inside an awaited spawn_blocking worker.

additions.name: archify_validate_candidate
additions.reason: Issue #433: validates a candidate diagram spec with the vendored, hash-pinned Archify engine (sidecars/archify, PIN.json). The job-private staging write under <work>/.maru/diagram-gen and the timeout-bounded node validate run happen inside an awaited spawn_blocking worker.

additions.name: document_delete_plan
additions.reason: Issue #441: read-only plan of the files a document delete would move to the system Trash (export bundle, versions, Studio outputs, Binder/Studio/kg-cache metadata) with a (relPath, size, mtime) fingerprint; manifest, frontmatter and state reads run inside an awaited spawn_blocking worker. trash_document keeps its baseline registration and becomes the reviewed apply step.
